title: Public Sector Economics
description: An introduction to public sector economic principles and theories. Topics include market failures such as: public goods and externalities; taxation and public spending; effectiveness, efficiency, equity and political feasibility criteria for policy evaluation and review processes. Applied public sector economics and Indigenous economics are discussed.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 310, ADMN 403, ECON 100, ECON 103, ECON 103C, ECON 104, ECON 180, ECON 201, ENGR 280 (if taken prior to May 2012).
